transcription: I need help, what legal actions can I take? Long story short, I found out yesterday that my ex that I've known for seven months. Also we were trying to work things out had slept with a 17-year-old last year. The thing is at that time he was 25. I found out from the girl because I texted her first BC I found her number on my ex's and they were having a conversation. So I memorized the number and texted her from my phone and wanted to see what was going on between my ex and her. At the time I didn't know anything of them or her we had a long conversation and she then told me about it, that at first she lied to him about being 18 which is weird still so they dated and then she came clear about the lie. She then told him that it was legal because of the Romeo and Juliet law in Texas. He broke things off with her, but they got back together a week later BC he said it was okay and not that bad BC of the law which he didn't do his own research and just believed her. I freaked out of course, confronted him about it and accused him of calling the cops if he doesn't do it. Because I was doing a research and the law only works if it's three-year difference. Clearly it was more than that. I had to message his brother about it and to let his parents know. My ex proceeded to tell me that he will call his lawyer and that if they tell him to go to the police that he will. I'm not sure if I can believe him. What can I do? Or is there nothing I can do?
